guidance.statement: There will be an upgrade in both the businesses (India and UK adhesive) because cost pressure is there and realizations are improving.
guidance.quote: Definitely there will be upgrade in both the businesses because the cost pressure is there, so because of their realizations are also improving.

guidance.statement: We are very well within our guided zone of 16%-18% EBITDA for the plumbing vertical.
guidance.quote: We have given guidance of 16%-18% EBITDA. Again, that we are on the higher side of 17.4% EBITDA in the H1. So, we are very well within our guided zone.

guidance.statement: Targeting full year volume of anywhere between 290,000 to 300,000 tons in the piping segment.
guidance.quote: ideally, we are targeting anywhere full year basis, anywhere between, you can say 290,000-to-300,000-ton type of total volume number.

guidance.statement: Bring the adhesive EBITDA margin back to normal levels, up to 13%, 14%, or 15% by the end of the fiscal year.
guidance.quote: again, to the margins of 13%, 14%, or up to 15%. We are all consciously working there.

guidance.statement: Paint business margins will not have new geographies opened until EBITDA touches around 9%-10%.
guidance.quote: we are not opening now any more geographies in Paint till we stabilize these states, grow in these states, and our EBITDA at least touches around 9%-10%.

analyst_concerns: Sustainability of volume growth and possibility of higher growth rates in H2.
Quantum and impact of price hikes passed on in plumbing and CPVC.
Upgrades to adhesive guidance for India and UK.
tone: Confident management highlighting market share gains, robust demand, and margin recovery despite input cost pressures.
